Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase Storage https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything.

We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all!

You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing.

You will be contributing to both our open source server https://github.com/supabase/storage and upstream dependencies we use, like the TUS server https://github.com/tus/tus-node-server/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+author%3Afenos+is%3Amerged.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

 - Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications

The Production Planner will be responsible for developing daily schedules and plans for production to ensure customer orders are processed in an efficient and timely manner. Familiarity with enterprise resource planning systems, data analysis, and attention to detail are critical to ensuring that production has a clear set of orders for the day, and expedite requests are monitored and tracked to completion. Candidate must have a high attention to detail and be able to communicate effectively with multiple teams. This is a great opportunity for candidates who are looking to explore careers outside of the laboratory and warehouse.

• Generate manufacturing build plans for critical stock to maintain lab supply.

• Reviewing daily production schedules for manufacturing to execute

• Review lab stock and conduct clear-to-build (CTB) assessments to confirm material availability meets production’s planned schedule.

• Own inventory discrepancy resolution across production labs and the shipping area.

• Establishing and reviewing Kanban levels for effectiveness and efficiency.

• Serve as point of contact for the production team’s inventory requirements, requests, and questions; communicate, track, and expedite special order requests for timely completion.

• Develop and maintain systematic reports to monitor effectiveness of production order output.

• Follow regulatory and ISO 13485 requirements.

• Assist in lab cycle counts and reconciliations.

• Analyze material usage, ensure efficient consumption per FEFO, and troubleshoot inventory issues such as shortages, expired, or short-dated stock.

• Reserve materials in the system and confirm/close work and production orders in a timely manner.
